{{Quote|Keep your heads down or that E-Web will take them off!|[[Reyé Hollis/Legends|Reyé Hollis]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />}}
The '''E-Web''' was a [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. It was one of the most powerful [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] arsenal, and had an optimum range of one-hundred and fifty meters with a maximum range of seven-hundred and fifty meters.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> The full name is '''Emplacement Weapon, Heavy Blaster''', but many users shortened this to E-Web.<ref name="EGW" /> The original weapon was designed in a joint effort with [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]], which produced the predecessor to the modern E-Web, the EWHB-10. Members of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] were trained to utilize the weapon, although its mass made it being carried by a single stormtrooper impossible, mandating that it be operated by two stormtroopers: one for firing the E-Web, and another monitoring and adjusting the generator's power feed to prevent overheating.<ref name="Handbook" />

==Description==
{{Quote|Without a second man it's very hard to shoot an E-Web. There's no fire control, you can't nurse your power supply or watch the cooler, and the gun is awkward to aim.|[[Reydon]]|<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
[[File:E-web.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An E-Web being prepared to fire during the Battle of Hoth.]]
The weapon was able to be broken down into parts and carried by a small crew of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] making it fairly mobile, but had to be rigidly mounted in order to counteract the effects of its incredible firepower. It took a relatively long amount of time to set up, and required two crew members for optimal effectiveness. One crewer manned the gun, and the other monitored and adjusted the [[Eksoan/Legends|Eksoan]] [[Class-4T3 power generator/Legends|Class-4T3 power generator]]. Like many high-yield generators, the 4T3 was prone to overheating and potentially explosive overload, despite its advanced [[Gk3 Cryocooler]] cooling unit.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> Power was fed into the E-Web via a conduit that connects to the base of the [[TR-62 Autocushion Tripod/Legends|TR-62 Autocushion Tripod]]. The built-in [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with automatic encryption allowed for secured communication with other units. The computerized fire control and targeting system included infrared and [[StarVision]] low-light enhancement for use in night combat. Overall, the E-Web can be transported and assembled for firing within a minute or less, although it will take up to ten minutes for its generator to reach full power.<ref name="Handbook" />

[[File:AqualishEweb-DC.png|thumb|200px|An [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] using an E-Web]]
The long set-up time was the E-Web's primary limitation. If the 4T3 generator was "cold," it could take nearly fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] for the crew to deploy the weapon, calibrate the generator and configure the targeting software.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook, Second Edition" /> Some Imperial crews pre-charged the generator before use for faster set-up, but this made it prone to power surges. Thus, the second crew member had to carefully adjust power flow to prevent an overload.<ref name="EGW" /> Imperial Snowtroopers on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] were able to set up and fire an E-Web in a matter of seconds in this fashion.

A single soldier could operate the E-Web, but at greatly reduced efficiency. In such cases, the gunner chose a power generator preset mode, which greatly reduced the rate of fire, but kept the E-Web and its generator operating at safe temperatures.<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Its retail price was 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], a small price to pay from the Empire's infinite coffers.

Maintenance of the weapon required monthly disassembly, inspection, repair, and reassembly.<ref name="Handbook" />

===E-Web upgrades===
There were several upgrades to the E-Web on the market, including the [[F-Web Repeating Blaster|F-Web]], the [[M-Web repeating blaster]] and the [[E-Web(15) Heavy Repeating Blaster|EWeb(15)]].

[[File:E-Web_heavy_repeating_blaster.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Two [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] operating an E-Web.]]
The F-Web added a small [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" /> that was powerful enough to block fire from small sidearms such as [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]. The shield offered good protection, but it required a third crew member to operate. This model was used primarily in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].

The EWeb(15) was released the year after [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death. It offered improved fire control and targeting software. With the generator's auto configure setting, the weapon could be set up in less than five minutes. The cooling system was also upgraded to the advanced [[Gk7 Cryocooler/Legends|Gk7 Cryocooler]] offering increased power flow into the weapon without the risk of overheating.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" /> This allowed continuous fire for up to one hour. Many EWeb(15) units were equipped with a shield generator.

The [[E-Web rifle]] was a portable version of the E-Web heavy repeating blaster.

The E-Web itself had some modifications of its own, including a high-fire repeater setting and automated sentry turret modification kit.<ref name="Handbook" />

==History==
===Pre-Clone Wars===
The E-Web was used by [[Granta Omega]] in an attempt to [[Mission to Korriban (23 BBY)|murder]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The weapon overheated and exploded, severely wounding Omega.<ref name="Jedi Quest">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
The [[EWHB-12 heavy repeating blaster]] was used by clone commandos as a distraction to [[Mission to Qiilura|infiltrate]] a Separatist nanovirus facility on [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]] that was producing a nanovirus capable of killing all clones.<ref name="RC:HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> It was also used in the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].<ref name="Jedi Trial" />

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:E-Web_CEIII.jpg|thumb|224px|Snowtroopers [[Battle of Pallaxides|battled]] [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces at [[Pallaxides]] with the E-Web.]]
[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] set up E-Webs to defend backwater [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] took control of an E-Web to shoot down an [[Armored Personnel Carrier]] carrying the captured defector, [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]. Soon after, he took control of one on a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] to eliminate boarding stormtroopers.<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

The E-Webs also saw use at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="SWE5" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> in a [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]],<ref name="RS III" /> and the [[Mission to Cilpar]].<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 2|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 2]]</ref>

It was used on Tatooine in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] by stormtroopers trying to prevent the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from escaping. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] blasted the troopers with an on-board laser cannon before they could set up the E-Web.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The E-Web's first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] was in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The E-Webs have appeared in LEGO form, both in real life and in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''.

There are slight differences in this weapon's range presented in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]'' that differ from the range as listed in the ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''. According to the Saga Edition, the optimum range is up to 75 meters and the maximum range is up to 750 meters.
